item.title: Filtering Messages with RecordFilterStrategy
item.description: Why Filter at the Container Level? Multiple consumers can share a topic. The inventory service only cares about PLACED orders; the analytics service wants everything. Rather than putting if (event.getStatus() != PLACED) return; at the top of every listener, Spring Kafka lets you filter records before they reach your method — keeping business logic clean and making the filter reusable across listeners. How RecordFilterStrategy Works flowchart LR Broker -->|"poll() → [r1, r2, r3, r4]"
